name: Shemaiah
overview: Shemaiah was a male Levite belonging to the Merarite clan, descendants of Merari son of Levi. He is uniquely identified as the son of Hasshub, situating him within the Levitical genealogies. His role and identity are preserved within the context of the priestly and Levitical families.
namesAndTitles: The name Shemaiah means 'YHWH hears,' reflecting a theologically rich understanding of God's attentiveness. This proper name is recorded in 1 Chronicles 9:14 and highlights the spiritual significance attributed to his identity.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Shemaiah as the son of Hasshub, as noted in 1 Chronicles 9:14. Beyond this, no additional family relationships are provided in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Shemaiah's importance lies in his place within the Levitical lineage, specifically among the Merarites, who were entrusted with duties related to the tabernacle. His genealogical mention underscores the faithfulness of God's covenant people in maintaining priestly service and order as outlined in Scripture.
